title: Longest Absolute File Path
description: Find the length of the longest absolute path to a file in a file system represented by a string.
pseudocode:
1. stack = {0: 0}
2. maxLen = 0
3. for line in input.split('\n'):
4.   depth = line.lastIndexOf('\t') + 1
5.   name = line.replace(/\t/g, '')
6.   if (name.includes('.')) maxLen = Math.max(maxLen, stack[depth] + name.length)
7.   else stack[depth + 1] = stack[depth] + name.length + 1

steps.note: Initialize stack map where stack[depth] stores current path length.
Update stack: depth 1 now has length 3 (dir).
Depth is 1, found '.' so it's a file.
Update stack: depth 2 now has length 4 + 6 + 1 = 11.
